name: My 2026 League

scoring.note: ESPN scoringType is H2H_POINTS; the 0.5 PPR reception value is carried over from the board and is NOT confirmed against ESPN's scoringItems. Nothing in the draft assistant computes fantasy points, so this only matters if projections are added later.

roster.note: CONFIRMED from ESPN lineupSlotCounts {0:1 QB, 2:2 RB, 4:2 WR, 6:1 TE, 16:1 DST, 23:3 FLEX, 20:5 BE, 21:1 IR}. THREE flex slots, not two, and no kicker. 10 starters + 5 bench = 15 rounds.

derived.why_it_matters: 3 FLEX + 2RB + 2WR + 1TE means up to 80 RB/WR/TE start weekly across 10 teams. That is MORE flex pressure than the original 12-team/2-FLEX assumption implied (8.0 vs 4.5 RB/WR/TE starters per team), so RB/WR depth matters even more, while the smaller league means better players last longer. No kicker frees a bench slot for a handcuff or second DST.

confirmed_from: Confirmed against the connected league's ESPN mSettings/mDraftDetail on 2026-08-23. League id, team ids, and team names are deliberately not recorded in this file — it is committed to a public repo. Re-derive them at runtime from the connected account.
